caption: Power goes from AC system A through the rectifier, along the DC line, through the inverter into AC system B. The DC section carries no charging current, and each converter station draws reactive power from its own AC system.

spec.title: Bipolar HVDC link
spec.aria: AC system A feeds a rectifier station that sends DC along a ±500 kV line to an inverter station, which feeds AC system B; both stations carry filters.
